title: Stefan Zweig — An International Bibliography. Digital edition
description: Digital edition of the Stefan Zweig bibliography compiled by Randolph J. Klawiter (University of Notre Dame), extracted from the decommissioned MediaWiki database of the bibliography and structured as JSON-LD with Schema.org, Dublin Core and a domain vocabulary, with the pipeline, validation evidence and a static research interface. The edition covers the current pages of the wiki; titles the wiki recorded as deleted are outside the scope of version 1.0. The archival database dump is preserved separately and is not part of this archive.
